opening.argument: The video centers on warning viewers about alleged problems, not asking them to invest or provide money or data: the speaker says he “just wanted to warn you guys about that” while discussing MTI users “not being able to withdraw their funds.” It also presents critical scrutiny of RagingBull’s promotional claims, quoting that regulators found “nothing to substantiate its claims that consumers are likely to make market beating returns that they're advertising.” The discussion further advises existing customers that “if you are a current subscriber of raging book you might want to opt out of your next subscription as quickly as possible.” References to external updates therefore function in the context of criticism and consumer caution, rather than as a concrete investment solicitation.
